texte: Contents: Shadows in the Night, Dark Protégé, and Standard encounter sets. One modular encounter set (Ninja Swarm). Setup: Put each The Streets Below environment into play. Set the Dark Protégé encounter set aside. Choose 1 random villain from that set and reveal its side A, then shuffle each card linked to that villain into the encounter deck.

In expert mode, the villain gets +1 SCH and +3[per_hero] hit points. Forced Interrupt: When the villain would be defeated on side A, instead flip it to side B, reset its hit points, and change the villain's position. Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card. If the villain is defeated on side B, the players win the game.
